text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: "—Come along, Brian!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I had that dream again. Chasing after her back.
A sweet dream where every stride shaking the earth filled my soul with purpose—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —and a fragile dream, at that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training course was electric with palpable heat.
At the center of it all stood a lone horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...So that's Narita Brian.
She hasn't even debuted yet, but what an overwhelming presence...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
So the rumors were true after all.
She's challenging graded race winners to unofficial matchups...!

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Let's set the distance to whatever suits you best.
How about 2,000 meters?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is that a distance where you can give it your all?

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Of course, against someone like you. As your senior, giving you an advantage is only fair.
That is my one non-negotiable condition for accepting this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Fine then. Whatever you say.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Woaaahhh~! Hayahide, over here, over here, over hereee!!
Brian's race is starting alreaaadyyy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Ticket. I can hear your voice more than clearly.
So please, compose yourself.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, how can I be calm?!
Her opponent today is inssssanely strong, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Even Brian would be totally crushed if she lost big time—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She will not.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand her strength better than anyone.
...And the burdens she has had to shoulder because of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (............Ahead of me, her hair and tail sway in the wind.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(They say she's a G1-caliber racer.
Her ability is the real deal. Which means... there's no need for me to hold back!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Are you coming, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Awa-wa-wa-wa... H-Hayahideee~~!!
They're past the fourth corner and the gap is—the gap isss...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is widening.
For an ordinary horsegirl, that distance might indeed be insurmountable.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...If she were an ordinary horsegirl, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*THUD THUD THUD THUD!*)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
W-What in the world is that speed...?! 
She's closing the gap at an unbelievable rate...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Three lengths... two lengths............ No, she's well within striking distance already!
Incredible, this is incredible! Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh! ...No way... that was entirely my pace...!
To an undebuted girl... there's no way... she could catch up to me... ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (............Yes. You are strong.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(So please, keep letting me chase you.
Please don't let me overtake you just yet.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Show me your fighting spirit right to the bitter end.
And please—!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (...Is this where it ends, yet again?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump, thump, tap... tap... tap...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(How many times have I watched that spark die out right before my eyes?
How many times have I watched someone get swallowed by the darkness?)

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Brian slowed down right before the goal line.
Did she run out of stamina at the very end?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Th-Then does that mean the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*...
...*huff*...

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Jeez, taking on races
without permission is a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ...I'm... sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well, sure, she was an underclassman, but winning a 2,000m race is
pretty impressive! As expected, you're—

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Please, stop. After witnessing talent like that,
I don't... want to hear your hollow platitudes...!

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I didn't win at all...! Against a monster like that...
someone like me had no right even trying to compete...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. What's with this mood...?
Why does she look so miserable even though she won?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming difference in power. When forced to confront something
so completely out of reach, what takes root isn't passion, but sheer dread.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A force that instills equal despair in every rival she faces.
That is Narita Brian... my younger sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite how fiercely contested the race had been,
Narita Brian's match came to an end in an eerie, unsettling silence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl whom the trainers whisper holds "something bottomless."
I came here hoping to catch a glimpse of that with my own eyes, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something about her running left me unsettled. The sudden loss of momentum
after that incredible burst of acceleration, and the pained look on her face.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I'll understand if I talk to her directly.
...Perhaps I could understand if I spoke to her myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My encounter with Narita Brian began
with that strange sense of dissonance—
